audit_items.proof_trace: The Discord guild membership check in the auth callback is explicitly commented out (lines 105-119, comment: '一時的にコメントアウト'), so no Discord verification occurs at login time — a Supabase session is established for any user found in member.members regardless of current Discord membership. The compensating control in dashboard/layout.tsx (L127-153) performs a live Discord check on every route render, but this does not cover direct server action invocations (Next.js Server Actions are callable via POST with a valid session cookie, bypassing the layout entirely).
audit_items.attack_scenario: A user who was removed from the Discord server retains a valid Supabase session; they are blocked from dashboard UI pages but can directly POST to server action endpoints (e.g., attendance recording in actions.ts) using their session cookie, performing operations without passing the Discord membership gate.
